title: Automated Logistics Manifest Verification
problem: Manual verification of physical shipping manifests against digital inventory records is error-prone and slows down throughput during high-volume periods.
solution: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct acts as a vision-language agent that processes images of physical shipping documents, extracting structured data to compare against database entries, effectively automating the reconciliation process.
steps: Capture high-resolution images of incoming physical shipping manifests using warehouse scanning stations.
Format the image data into the model-specific chat template, ensuring the vision tokens are correctly placed for the model to interpret the document structure.
Prompt the model to extract specific fields like Order ID, SKU counts, and destination codes from the visual input.
Compare the extracted JSON output from the model against the existing Warehouse Management System (WMS) records for discrepancies.
outcome: Increased accuracy in inventory tracking and reduced manual labor hours required for document processing.
limitation: The model may struggle with low-contrast or damaged physical documents; performance should be verified by implementing a confidence threshold on the extracted text fields.
